purpose: Connect previously committed exact MAE byte scorer to bounded nofollow artifact/reference/ID file reads in trusted scorer context; generate bounded rounded development metric only. No automatic launch/lifecycle/controller-termination/hidden-reveal claim.
input: Trusted immutable paths + exact expected hash/size/mtime ceilings + scorer limits. Paths are not model args. Feature CSV or ordered ID byte manifest supplies IDs; target CSV must exactly match ordered Id,SalePrice. All parsed/hash checks from the same bounded bytes; reject links/special files/traversal, stale mtimes/identity.
output: Internal exact Fraction MAE and identity-only receipts. Expose development metric as six-place decimal with exact row count and trusted run/source IDs; errors safe enum only. Hidden score stays root-only and requires separate actual controller termination/final lock gate before invocation.
fixed_metric: Original-unit SalePrice MAE; finite negative predictions valid; no log transform, hidden archive best or floor imputation.
validation: Synthetic tests compare known exact rational score, reference/ID swap, postlock same-size mutations, symlink/hardlink/FIFO, stale mtimes, byte/row/numeric caps, malformed target contract and no raw payload in public output/errors.
